name: Nexus PLM
_comment_onlyofficeScheme: Load this plugin under the editor's own onlyoffice:// scheme instead of file://. Measured on Desktop Editors 9.4.0: without it the page has an OPAQUE origin (file://) and every fetch and XMLHttpRequest to the Addin Service fails. The three shipped plugins that make network calls - AI, AI agent and DeepL - are the only ones that set this, and sdk-all.js rewrites baseUrl to onlyoffice://plugin/<path> when they do.

variations._comment: FIRST, and it is what puts the tab in the ribbon - the only thing measured to work. It is a ONE-SHOT action: it runs, registers the tab, and is torn down (its heartbeat stops, proven by last_seen never advancing). The tab's registration survives, which is why the tab stays. Clicks on it have no frame to reach, so the PANEL is what actually runs commands - see index.html.
The panel. Long-lived while open, so it is what runs commands, keeps the tray heartbeat going, and re-registers the tab with live enabled states.
Last, where every plugin shipped with Desktop Editors puts About. It shows the service's own About window, so the version and the server are reported the same way in every Nexus host.
